title: Data Operations Associate
description:
ABOUT MIDDESK:

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

THE ROLE

We have rapidly expanded our product suite, and the operational surface area needed to support it has grown with it. We are looking for a systems and process expert to help us scale our internal operations infrastructure gracefully and at a reasonable cost, while we maintain product quality and performance. That same person should be adept at taking things from concept to reality when the need for new products or procedures arises.

If you want to have a large impact on a growing product, and to work in a fast-paced environment, we would like to talk with you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Become an expert in the data that powers our products, and in everything it takes to keep that data accurate and recent.

- Design, operate, and streamline high-volume fulfillment workflows that deliver successful client outcomes.

- Automate recurring operational work so that it runs without manual intervention, and measure the time and cost that you remove.

- Build the dashboards and analyses that show how our data and fulfillment processes perform, and use them to find the largest improvement opportunities.

- Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Sales, Product, and Customer Experience to launch new products, improve existing processes, and create multi-team procedures.

- Partner with Finance to find operational inefficiencies and propose solutions that weigh financial and operational cost against benefit.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- At least two years of experience in consulting, finance, strategy, or business operations.

- Experience that shows you can design, scale, and maintain high-volume processes, with a focus on software-driven systems.

- Experience that shows you can use data to find insights, drive action, and solve problems. We strongly prefer candidates who understand SQL and build dashboards.

- The ability to use operational expertise to advise Product and Engineering teams on turning processes into internal and external products.

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience at a B2B SaaS startup or a financial services company.

- Exposure to vendor management or to leading outsourced teams, or an interest in growing into that work.

- Exposure to unit-cost tracking for operational and fulfillment processes.

- Experience that automates manual work with scripting, workflow tools, or AI-assisted tooling.

description:
Entreprises et particuliers sont touchés de plein fouet par la révolution de l’intelligence artificielle et notamment l’intelligence artificielle générative (GenIA) proposant une capacité unique de création de contenus.
Ses capacités ont rapidement été étendues à la génération de code, permettant ainsi d’optimiser de manière importante le temps de développement de logiciels. De l’utilisation personnelle à des produits d’entreprises, l’IA est aujourd’hui présente dans une grande partie des activités du développeur.
Tout comme les autres métiers dans la création (notamment artistique), le métier de développeur se retrouve ainsi radicalement impacté par l’essor de ces technologies.
Ainsi, ce stage devra apporter des éléments de réponse à la problématique suivante : 
L’Intelligence artificielle dans le développement logiciel : quelles opportunités pour les entreprises ?
La phase d’étude
Rattaché(e) au bureau Suisse de Wavestone , l’objectif du stage est d’étudier les cas d’usages et impacts des fonctionnalités basées sur l’IA, et plus spécifiquement l’IA générative, en ce qui concerne les activités du développeur en entreprise.
Travail préparatoire :
Le début de stage sera marqué par une note de cadrage visant à définir précisément les contours de l’étude et la problématique(s) de recherche, en s’appuyant sur la connaissance existante du marché et du sujet apportée par Wavestone . De plus, la note de cadrage a pour objectif d’aligner les attentes du cabinet Wavestone sur le(s) livrable(s) du stage.
Nous proposons un stage s’articulant autour des objectifs suivants :

• Étude des cas d’usages de l’IA dans les activités de développement :

• Identification des cas d’usages et typologie de fonctionnalité offertes par l’IA pour les développeurs ; génération de code, revue de copie et optimisation, identification de vulnérabilité, conception de solution, …

• Étude des gains escomptés, impacts et risques associés à l’utilisation de service d’IA en entreprise :

• Déterminer des métriques de mesures de gains escomptés et prioriser les cas d’usages d’IA au service du développement à ces métriques

• Identifier les risques liés à la nature des services IA (ex : fuite de données, propriété intellectuelle, backdoor sur le réseau interne, …)

• Identifier les risques liés à la nature des activités réalisées par l’IA (ex : sous-optimisation algorithmique, effet de bord (unexpected behavior), perte de contrôle/connaissance technique des solutions développées, maintenance et évolutivité, …)

• Identifier les impacts liés à la transformation des activités et rôles dans l’entreprise (ex : modification des activités du développeur, transformation des équipes et modèle opérationnel, …)

• Concevoir les solutions et bonnes pratiques vis-à-vis de l’adoption de service d’IA dans l’activité de développement logiciel :

• Sur la base de l’inventaire des cas d’usages et des risques, déterminer une priorisation de l’adoption des cas d’usage pour l’entreprise et les mesures à prendre afin de mitiger les risques et impacts de la transformation

• Évaluer les solutions et bonnes pratiques conçues face aux réalités du marché et des entreprises :

• Grâce à la connaissance des différents environnements des clients du cabinet Wavestone , déterminer les tendances du marché, les résultats escomptés et mesurés. Évaluer ces données empiriques avec les solutions et bonnes pratiques conçues dans l’objectif précédent.

• Contributions au cabinet de conseil

En tant que consultant stagiaire, vous serez également amené à contribuer aux missions opérationnelles de nos clients.
Nous vous donnons également la possibilité de participer activement à la vie interne du cabinet à travers :

• L’appui au développement de notre expertise CTO Advisory : contribution aux actions de prospection et d’élaboration de propositions commerciales

• Production de radars d’acteurs visant à mieux comprendre les acteurs du numérique responsable

• La production de supports visant à acculturer

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance. That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we're not done. Not even close.

We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken - you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

As a Senior Product Manager at Satispay, you'll take ownership of one of our core product domains - payments, credit, investing, cards, or merchant solutions - and turn it into a simple, engaging experience for millions of users. The exact domain will be shaped around your background and our current priorities, but the day-to-day looks like this:

- Roadmap ownership - Own the roadmap for your product area end to end, from opportunity sizing to shipped feature, backed by data and user research.

- Complexity, made simple - Navigate the regulatory and technical complexity that comes with building financial products, while keeping the experience radically simple for the end user.

- Compliance collaboration - Work closely with compliance, legal, and risk teams given the regulated nature of financial products.

- User research - Talk to users constantly (interviews, usability tests, support tickets) and turn what you hear into concrete product decisions.

- Execution & iteration - Define specs and work day-to-day with design and engineering to ship, then iterate based on what the numbers tell you.

- KPI management - Track and own your core KPIs (activation, adoption, volumes/revenue) and report on them without spin.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This role needs someone data-driven and user-centric, who thrives on turning complex financial products into simple, engaging consumer experiences - and who's excited to bring that mindset to one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs.

- Experience - At least 5+ years of experience in a Product Manager role, ideally within fintech, paytech, or another consumer-facing scale-up, with exposure to regulated products (payments, lending, investing, insurance) or genuine technical/operational complexity.

- Fintech / paytech mindset - You bring a proven track record of building and scaling consumer or B2B financial products, paired with a genuine, contagious passion for the world of finance and payments.

- Data-driven mindset - You build hypotheses, validate them, and rely on analytics to lead the way.

- User-centric focus - You prioritize direct user feedback and research over unverified assumptions.

- Cross-functional collaboration - You thrive working alongside designers and engineers every day, staying involved far beyond just handing over specifications.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.
